verdict.rationale: GA4 documents event collection from websites, web and mobile apps, and connected devices. Backend events can be sent server-to-server via the Measurement Protocol, and web collection uses the Google tag/gtag snippet. However, the Measurement Protocol is a raw HTTP protocol rather than an official per-language SDK, and the Java/Python/Node.js/etc. client libraries in the pack belong to the reporting Data API, not event ingestion, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of official ingestion SDKs for backend languages, named mobile SDK documentation (iOS/Android), and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-platform ingestion.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send events from web, mobile, and backend apps through official SDKs for the major languages and platforms
